description: This file contains functions for collecting and assigning secret configuration values for various components of the openclaw system, including providers, skills, agents, media, and gateways. It manages secret input collection, validation, and application across different configuration sections.

methods.name: collectModelProviderAssignments
methods.description: Collects and assigns secret values for model providers based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: collectSkillAssignments
methods.description: Collects and assigns secret values for skill entries.

methods.name: collectAgentMemorySearchAssignments
methods.description: Handles secret collection for agent memory search configurations.

methods.name: collectTalkAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret values for talk API keys and providers.

methods.name: collectGatewayAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret values related to gateway authentication and remote tokens.

methods.name: collectProviderRequestAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret values for provider request headers, auth, and TLS settings.

methods.name: collectMediaRequestAssignments
methods.description: Handles secret collection for media understanding models and requests.

methods.name: collectMessagesTtsAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret values for message TTS configurations.

methods.name: collectCronAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret for cron webhook token.

methods.name: collectSandboxSshAssignments
methods.description: Handles secret collection for sandbox SSH agent configurations.

methods.name: collectCoreConfigAssignments
methods.description: Main exported function that orchestrates collection of secrets across all configuration sections.
